currentPhase.description: RC715 remains the promoted standalone forensic baseline. RC718 remains the active development candidate pending RC719 human validation. Permanent Player CI, Remote Agent Worktree, pull-request scope enforcement and branch hygiene are operational. A main-protection ruleset is configured but GitHub reports that it is not enforced on this private personal-account repository without moving to a GitHub Team organization account.

developmentBaseline.candidate: RC718 editable imported plan naming candidate

promotedBaseline.candidate: RC715 durable library and rename candidate

branchHygiene.policy: main-only when no pull request is open

mainRuleset.name: main-protection
mainRuleset.reason: GitHub UI reports that rulesets are not enforced on this private repository until it is moved to a GitHub Team organization account.

authorizedWork: standalone functional, UX, accessibility, persistence, performance, test, and release improvements through bounded pull requests
bounded multi-file AI implementation through the accepted Remote Agent Worktree with exact baseline, machine-checkable scope and explicit test profile
permanent player CI and black-box behavioral protection
pull-request changed-file scope enforcement through canonical work packages
preparation of one bounded and reversible architectural seam
heldWork: implementation of the first architectural seam until ARC-WP-010 is reviewed and accepted
localStorage to IndexedDB migration until a dedicated migration gate is accepted
prohibitedWork: maintaining a separate canonical standalone source outside GitHub
mixing a functional correction with a transversal architecture, storage, identifier, or contract migration
microservices before a demonstrated extraction need
synchronization of opaque global snapshots as the sole merge model
canonical identifiers derived from editable titles
direct UI coupling to storage or remote APIs
parallel AI implementation without exact baseline and machine-checkable scopes
publishing an artifact different from the artifact tested
presenting target architecture as current implementation
using the Remote Agent fast lane for workflows, governance, architecture, work packages, secrets or held platform domains
broadening work-package allowedPaths merely to silence PR scope failures

activeRisks.statement: The main-protection ruleset is correctly configured but GitHub explicitly reports that it is not enforced on this private personal-account repository. Repository checks remain operational and auditable, but direct administrative bypass is not technically blocked by plan-level policy enforcement.
activeRisks.closureGate: move the repository to an eligible GitHub Team organization account or adopt another GitHub plan/topology that enforces private-repository rulesets

activeRisks.statement: The RC715 human promotion is recorded as accountable-owner attestation without raw device recordings or per-case human test logs in the repository.
activeRisks.closureGate: optional attachment of detailed human evidence or acceptance of owner attestation as the durable record

activeRisks.statement: RC718 plan-name editing passed the complete permanent CI matrix but has not yet completed the focused Android and desktop close/reopen human gate.

activeExceptions.justification: The repository remains on the current private personal-account setup. The configured ruleset is retained as the target policy, while all changes continue through documented PR, CI, scope and governor procedures.
activeExceptions.reviewTrigger: repository plan or ownership topology change, serious governance bypass, or first external collaborator

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Define and governor-review the first narrow reversible storage-boundary seam without changing storage technology, data shape, identifiers, UI, or behavior. RC719 human validation remains separately required before RC718 can replace the promoted standalone baseline. The unenforced ruleset remains a known accepted operational risk, not a blocker for bounded single-owner work.

review.lastReviewedBy: Architecture & Repository Governor — ruleset enforcement verification
review.nextReviewTrigger: ARC-WP-010 proposal, RC719 human naming/persistence result, repository ownership or plan change, first external collaborator, serious regression, release provenance change, or phase-gate request
